description: Pankow UPick Orchards is a independent farm in 5878 Glen Iris Rd, NY. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
